say:0:1320202001:0.text: Looks like this campfire is still hot...
say:0:1320202001:0.source_cn: 这堆篝火是刚刚生过的。
say:0:1320202001:0.male: Looks like this campfire is still hot...
say:0:1320202001:0.female: Looks like this campfire is still hot...

say:1:1320202002:0.text: Could there be someone else here with us in this forest?
say:1:1320202002:0.source_cn: 难道除了我们，还有人出没黑森林沼泽？

say:2:1320202003:0.text: It wouldn't make much sense for someone else to be here. Let's check the area.
say:2:1320202003:0.source_cn: 按理说不会有人，附近看看吧。
say:2:1320202003:0.male: It wouldn't make much sense for someone else to be here. Let's check the area.
say:2:1320202003:0.female: It wouldn't make much sense for someone else to be here. Let's check the area.

say:2:1320203001:1.text: The string on this bow is freshly oiled! Someone's been taking care of it lately!
say:2:1320203001:1.source_cn: 这把弓的弓弦上涂着油脂！像是最近保养过的呢！

say:3:1320203002:1.text: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:3:1320203002:1.source_cn: 野果是新鲜的，架上烤肉也还没来得及吃。\n<style...
say:3:1320203002:1.male: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:3:1320203002:1.female: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:4:1320203002.text: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:4:1320203002.source_cn: 野果是新鲜的，架上烤肉也还没来得及吃。\n<style=stress><player_name></style>，这到底是怎么回事？
choice_prompt:4:1320203002.male: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:4:1320203002.female: These fruits are fresh and there's meat on the grill, almost like someone didn't have time to eat it. What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:5:1320203003:1.text: And they took off without even finishing their meal?
say:5:1320203003:1.source_cn: 连饭都不吃，忽然离开了？

say:6:1320203005:1.text: I found some more bowstring in the cabin. Judging from the quality craftsmanship, it must belong to a hunter.
say:6:1320203005:1.source_cn: 我刚才在屋子里还发现了一些麻绳，看麻绳的工艺应该是猎人的。

say:7:1320203006:1.text: Hunting in this forest? That's way too dangerous!
say:7:1320203006:1.source_cn: 在黑森林沼泽打猎？未免太危险了吧！

say:8:1320203007:1.text: Speaking of danger... Magister, did you just hear something?
say:8:1320203007:1.source_cn: 说到危险……主人，你听到什么声音了吗？
say:8:1320203007:1.male: Speaking of danger... Magister, did you just hear something?
say:8:1320203007:1.female: Speaking of danger... Magister, did you just hear something?

say:10:1320203004:1.text: That's right. They took off without even finishing their meal.
say:10:1320203004:1.source_cn: 是的，连饭都没吃，忽然离开了。

choice:4:1:2.text: Whoever it is, they left in a hurry.
choice:4:1:2.male: Whoever it is, they left in a hurry.
choice:4:1:2.female: Whoever it is, they left in a hurry.

say:2:1320206001:0.text: Phew! You guys were just like in those adventure stories—you arrived just in time to save my skin!
say:2:1320206001:0.source_cn: 哈！你们就像故事里讲的那样！在俺吓破胆的时候登场了！

choice_prompt:3:1320206001.text: Phew! You guys were just like in those adventure stories—you arrived just in time to save my skin!
choice_prompt:3:1320206001.source_cn: 哈！你们就像故事里讲的那样！在俺吓破胆的时候登场了！

say:4:1320206004:1.text: You can call me Kliff, I'm a hunter—although I was just about to be someone else's prey...
say:4:1320206004:1.source_cn: 俺叫克利夫，是一名猎人，虽然刚才差点就成猎物了……

say:5:1320206005:1.text: You've been hunting in the Duskmire Forest?
say:5:1320206005:1.source_cn: 你一直在黑森林沼泽狩猎吗？

say:6:1320206006:1.text: No one sane would ever hunt here! It was a total accident...
say:6:1320206006:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！俺是误入这里的……

say:7:1320206007:1.text: I had my eyes on this pretty little mink, which would have been an easy kill, but I wanted to catch it alive so its fur would still be intact!
say:7:1320206007:1.source_cn: 起初俺是盯上一只漂亮的鼬鼠，如果要杀掉它很容易，但是活...

say:8:1320206008:1.text: I was super caught up chasing this mink.
say:8:1320206008:1.source_cn: 谁知道那小畜生“滑溜”得很，俺不知道追了它多久。

say:9:1320206009:1.text: Before I realized it, I'd already wandered into this forest. How careless of me!
say:9:1320206009:1.source_cn: 回过神来时人已经在黑森林了，真是大意！

say:10:1320206010:0.text: I tried to leave at first, but it seemed like there was no way out of this damned place. No matter which direction I walked, it was like I was going in circles!
say:10:1320206010:0.source_cn: 俺的第一反应是赶紧离开，但这鬼地方就像没有出口一样，无...

say:11:1320206011:0.text: You guys seem really knowledgeable. Any idea what's going on?
say:11:1320206011:0.source_cn: 你们看起来见多识广，能看看这是咋回事吗？

choice_prompt:12:1320206011.text: You guys seem really knowledgeable. Any idea what's going on?
choice_prompt:12:1320206011.source_cn: 你们看起来见多识广，能看看这是咋回事吗？

say:14:1320206013:1.text: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.
say:14:1320206013:1.source_cn: 会让人迷失在黑森林中的怪物，已经被<style=str...
say:14:1320206013:1.male: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.
say:14:1320206013:1.female: It's a type of creature that makes people lose their way in this forest. But don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> here already got rid of all of them! Nobody should get lost again.

say:15:1320206014:1.text: Hah! Looks like I need to thank you guys twice! I have to thank my wife for that amulet, too!
say:15:1320206014:1.source_cn: 哈！看样子俺要感谢你们两次了！噢不对，是三次！还要感谢...

say:17:1320206015:1.text: I only wore it because she nagged me to death. Maybe this amulet is why I got so lucky!
say:17:1320206015:1.source_cn: 如果不是她唠唠叨叨，俺才懒得戴，没准是这小东西让俺这么...

say:18:1320206016:1.text: Actually, I'm out hunting because I want to finish making my wife a new minkskin dress before the ceremony.
say:18:1320206016:1.source_cn: 不怕你们笑话，俺想在祭典前给老婆做件新衣服，拖了不知道...

say:19:1320206017:1.text: I've got to finish skinning this mink. Oh! As thanks for saving me, why don't you guys come rest at my village? Just head north and you'll find it.
say:19:1320206017:1.source_cn: 回去前俺得把鼬鼠的皮毛处理一下，对了，俺的村子就在沼泽...

say:20:1320206018:1.text: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.
say:20:1320206018:1.source_cn: 对了，如果你见到俺那位，能转达下平安吗？俺也出来好几天...
say:20:1320206018:1.male: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.
say:20:1320206018:1.female: Speaking of which, if you happen to see my wife, can you tell her I'm alright? I've been gone for days, so I'm sure she's worried.

say:21:1320206019:1.text: I gotta finish her dress as quickly as I can. I can't wait to see the surprise on her face!
say:21:1320206019:1.source_cn: 俺也有点等不及了呢，真想早点把她衣服做好了，看到她惊喜...

choice:12:0:1.text: It must've been a hawk moth.
choice:12:0:1.male: It must've been a hawk moth.
choice:12:0:1.female: It must've been a hawk moth.

say:23:1320206002:1.text: Prayers? Ahh... Right, I was praying silently!
say:23:1320206002:1.source_cn: 祈祷？啊……是的，俺算是在心里祈祷了吧！

say:24:1320206003:1.text: So this is what heroes look like? I guess it's pretty much what I imagined!
say:24:1320206003:1.source_cn: 原来英雄长这个样子！跟想象中也差不多嘛！

say:0:1320207001:0.text: Magister, this must be Kliff's village!
say:0:1320207001:0.source_cn: 主人，这应该就是克利夫大哥的村子了吧！
say:0:1320207001:0.male: Magister, this must be Kliff's village!
say:0:1320207001:0.female: Magister, this must be Kliff's village!

say:1:1320207002:0.text: There's an old man over there. Let's go talk to him.
say:1:1320207002:0.source_cn: 那边有位老爷爷，我们过去打听一下吧。

say:3:1320208001:1.text: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!
say:3:1320208001:1.male: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!
say:3:1320208001:1.female: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!

choice_prompt:4:1320208001.text: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!
choice_prompt:4:1320208001.male: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!
choice_prompt:4:1320208001.female: Speak louder, young one! I'm hard of hearin'!

say:6:1320208004:1.text: WE'RE. LOOKING FOR. HUNTER KLIFF'S WIFE!!!
say:6:1320208004:1.source_cn: 我们！在找！克利夫的妻子！！！

say:7:1320208005:1.text: Oh, Kliff! This furball here's got quite a voice on him!
say:7:1320208005:1.source_cn: 哦，克利夫，你这小胖球嗓门可不小。

say:8:1320208006:1.text: Right, so Kliff... Who's Kliff again? ... You guys are looking for Snowflake Pirdy's husband, right?
say:8:1320208006:1.source_cn: 对啊……克利夫，克利夫是谁来着……你们莫不是在找雪花珀...

say:9:1320208007:1.text: I suppose so? We know that Kliff is a hunter.
say:9:1320208007:1.source_cn: 应该是吧？我们认识的克利夫是一名猎人。

say:10:1320208008:1.source_cn: 呵、呵，那应该就是了，克利夫的确是名猎人。

say:11:1320208009:1.text: Hey, why can the old man hear you just fine?
say:11:1320208009:1.source_cn: 欸？为什么你讲话爷爷能听到？

say:12:1320208010:1.text: I don't know either. I guess my voice is a bit sharper?
say:12:1320208010:1.source_cn: 我也不懂，可能我的声音更尖锐一些？

say:13:1320208011:1.text: That man married Pirdy, who was from our village. Speaking of Pirdy... All the young men in town had a likin' for her.
say:13:1320208011:1.source_cn: 这个男人娶了我们村的珀蒂，说到珀蒂……当时村里所有的男...

say:14:1320208012:1.text: She was gorgeous like a snowflake—pure and unique. She was so kind and gentle, too, so everyone called her Snowflake.
say:14:1320208012:1.source_cn: 她美的就像是雪花一样冰清玉洁，为人也温柔善良，不知道从...

say:15:1320208013:1.text: Who knew she'd marry a rugged hunter from another village? He even had a funny accent! But he sure managed to capture his wife's heart somehow.
say:15:1320208013:1.source_cn: 唉，谁知道她嫁给了那个外乡来的猎人，操着一口土掉渣的口...

say:16:1320208014:1.text: Okay... Well, we're here to see Pirdy. Could you point us in her direction, please?
say:16:1320208014:1.source_cn: 呃……我们是来找珀蒂的，能麻烦您指下她家的方向吗？

say:17:1320208015:1.text: Her direction? You mean... You folks want to put flowers on her grave?
say:17:1320208015:1.source_cn: 她家？哦……你是说要给她的墓地献花吗？

say:19:1320208017:1.text: Well, yes. Ol' Pirdy died ages ago, back when I was still a young man.
say:19:1320208017:1.source_cn: 是的，早在几十年前珀蒂就去世了，那时候我还很年轻。

say:21:1320208019:1.text:
Yes, of course! Where was I...
Oh, right. Pirdy left us.
say:21:1320208019:1.source_cn: 是的啊，我说到哪了？\n噢对……珀蒂离开了我们。

say:22:1320208020:1.text: The story goes that Kliff went out hunting and didn't come back. We looked for him everywhere—except the Duskmire Forest, of course—and he didn't turn up anywhere.
say:22:1320208020:1.source_cn: 据说是因为克利夫外出狩猎没有回来，除了黑森林我们都找遍...

say:23:1320208021:1.text: Some say he must have gotten lost in the Duskmire Forest. Others say he just skipped town on his wife... But who knows what really happened?
say:23:1320208021:1.source_cn: 有人说他可能迷失在黑森林了，也有人说他丢下妻子跑了……...

say:24:1320208022:1.text: All I know is that ol' Pirdy missed her husband so much that she died of heartache on the day of the winter ceremony... The villagers here, we buried her with our own hands, right outside town.
say:24:1320208022:1.source_cn: 珀蒂因为太思念丈夫，在冬日祭奠当天郁郁而终了……村里人...

say:25:1320208023:1.text: It was hard on Pirdy. She just couldn't wait for her husband to find his way back. It was heartbreaking for all of us.
say:25:1320208023:1.source_cn: 真是苦了珀蒂，她最后也没能等到丈夫归来，我们所有人都很心痛。

say:26:1320208024:1.text: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.
say:26:1320208024:1.source_cn: 谢谢爷爷……主人，我们去墓地看看吧。
say:26:1320208024:1.male: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.
say:26:1320208024:1.female: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.

say:28:1320208026:1.text: I said THANKS, SIR!!! WE'RE GOING TO SEE HER GRAVE!!!
say:28:1320208026:1.source_cn: 我说谢谢爷爷！！！我们要去墓地看看！！！

say:29:1320208027:1.text: Oh, good kids, good kids you are... That's nice that you'll pay Pirdy a visit. We all miss her when winter ceremony time comes around.
say:29:1320208027:1.source_cn: 哦，好孩子……好孩子，探望下珀蒂也是好的，每年快到冬日...

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: （大声告知在找克利夫的妻子）

say:2:1320209001:1.text: That's her headstone alright. But... That old man seemed honest, so how is it that we were talking to Kliff earlier?
say:2:1320209001:1.source_cn: “她始终爱着未归来的丈夫，珀蒂”。\n的确是珀蒂的墓碑...

say:3:1320209002:1.text: I'm starting to think we've just been seeing things.
say:3:1320209002:1.source_cn: 我也渐渐开始不敢相信自己的眼睛了。

say:4:1320209003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?
say:4:1320209003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?
say:4:1320209003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't we head back to the cabin?

say:5:1320209004:1.text: Yeah! It seems like there's been some kind of misunderstanding!
say:5:1320209004:1.source_cn: 是呢！也许这是个误会也说不定！

say:0:1320210001:0.text: Strange. It seems so much worse than the last time we came.
say:0:1320210001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，跟上次来时的感觉差很多。
say:0:1320210001:0.male: Strange. It seems so much worse than the last time we came.
say:0:1320210001:0.female: Strange. It seems so much worse than the last time we came.

say:2:1320211001:1.text: Magister, all that fresh food is gone!
say:2:1320211001:1.source_cn: 主人，新鲜的食物都不见了！
say:2:1320211001:1.male: Magister, all that fresh food is gone!
say:2:1320211001:1.female: Magister, all that fresh food is gone!

say:3:1320211002:1.text: And the campfire has been dead for a long time...
say:3:1320211002:1.source_cn: 篝火也像是废弃很久的样子……

say:4:1320211003:1.text: There's only a few of the hunter's items left, and they don't look like they've been used in a long time.
say:4:1320211003:1.source_cn: 只剩下一些发霉的猎人道具，但看起来也很久没用过了。

say:5:1320211004:1.text: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?
say:5:1320211004:1.male: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?
say:5:1320211004:1.female: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?

choice_prompt:6:1320211004.text: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?
choice_prompt:6:1320211004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，这到底是怎么回事？你有什么头绪吗？
choice_prompt:6:1320211004.male: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?
choice_prompt:6:1320211004.female: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Do you have any ideas?

say:7:1320211005:1.source_cn: 我们再附近看看吧！主人！

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我们需要再找到点什么

say:9:1320211006:1.text: Oh! I hope we can see him again!
say:9:1320211006:1.source_cn: 唔！希望能再见到克利夫大哥一次。

choice:6:1:2.text: Let's go to where we last saw him.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 回见到克利夫的地方看看
choice:6:1:2.male: Let's go to where we last saw him.
choice:6:1:2.female: Let's go to where we last saw him.

say:0:1320212001:0.text: Okay, this is the last place we saw Kliff.
say:0:1320212001:0.source_cn: 这应该就是上次见到克利夫大哥的位置了！

say:1:1320212002:0.text: Let's see if we can find any clues.
say:1:1320212002:0.source_cn: 附近看看有什么线索吧。
say:1:1320212002:0.male: Let's see if we can find any clues.
say:1:1320212002:0.female: Let's see if we can find any clues.

say:2:1320213001:0.text: Look, Magister! Doesn't that look like Kliff's amulet?
say:2:1320213001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看这个！像不像是克利夫大哥的护身符？
say:2:1320213001:0.male: Look, Magister! Doesn't that look like Kliff's amulet?
say:2:1320213001:0.female: Look, Magister! Doesn't that look like Kliff's amulet?

say:4:1320213002:0.text: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...
say:4:1320213002:0.male: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...
say:4:1320213002:0.female: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...

choice_prompt:6:1320213002.text: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...
choice_prompt:6:1320213002.source_cn: 护身符已经腐烂了，<style=stress><player_name></style>，你说会不会是……
choice_prompt:6:1320213002.male: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...
choice_prompt:6:1320213002.female: The amulet has aged a lot. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think maybe...

say:7:1320213003:1.text: Yeah... Maybe his soul has been trying to find its way back to see Pirdy.
say:7:1320213003:1.source_cn: 是呢……也许他的灵魂一直期盼能回去看到妻子珀蒂。

say:8:1320213004:1.text: Right! We could help him fulfill his final wish! Then he can rest in peace!
say:8:1320213004:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯！也许我们帮他完成了遗愿！他就可以安心离开了！

say:9:1320213007:1.text: So do you think Kliff saw his wife?
say:9:1320213007:1.source_cn: 所以，克利夫大哥见到自己的妻子了吗？

choice_prompt:10:1320213007.text: So do you think Kliff saw his wife?
choice_prompt:10:1320213007.source_cn: 所以，克利夫大哥见到自己的妻子了吗？

say:12:1320213010:1.text: Anyway, I always hope that anyone who's trapped can break free from the darkness.
say:12:1320213010:1.source_cn: 无论如何，希望受困的人都能走出自己的阴霾吧。

say:15:1320213013:1.text: Don't you feel a bit strange saying that?
say:15:1320213013:1.source_cn: 你不觉得你说的这句话，有点让人感到羞羞的吗！

say:17:1320213015:1.text: Haha! ...But this is what Chippy was thinking: what if it was Chippy who was trapped here?
say:17:1320213015:1.source_cn: 哈哈……不过！满满喜欢你这话喔！其实刚才就在想，如果满...

say:18:1320213016:1.text: You know, Magister, Chippy knows you'd come.
say:18:1320213016:1.source_cn: 你知道吗，主人，满满觉得你一定会来的，就是这种安全感让...
say:18:1320213016:1.male: You know, Magister, Chippy knows you'd come.
say:18:1320213016:1.female: You know, Magister, Chippy knows you'd come.

say:19:1320213017:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，我们都会来的啦！

say:20:1320213018:1.text: Hehe... It's great to have you both as friends.

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 他们会在另一个世界相遇

choice:6:0:1.text: What we saw was his spirit.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我们看到的是克利夫的亡魂
choice:6:0:1.male: What we saw was his spirit.
choice:6:0:1.female: What we saw was his spirit.

say:24:1320213005:1.text: You're right. After all, he did finish skinning that mink.
say:24:1320213005:1.source_cn: 是呢……毕竟他已经处理完鼬鼠的皮毛了。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1320201001:.text: A cabin! I see a cabin!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320201001:.source_cn: 小木屋！满满看到一个小木屋！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1320201002:.text: That's perfect. We can go rest a bit!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320201002:.source_cn: 我们刚好可以过去休息下。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1320205001:.text: Not good! We have to help him, Magister!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320205001:.source_cn: 不好！主人！我们得帮帮他！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320205001:.male: Not good! We have to help him, Magister!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320205001:.female: Not good! We have to help him, Magister!
